passives.name: Evasion

passives.name: Sharpshooting
passives.description:
Increases Ranged Critical Rate +3% and Ranged Critical Damage +15%.
Deadeye and Float now grant the Feral Mark buff, allowing the caster to inflict Feral Aura on enemies with each attack.

Feral Aura:
- Reduces target's Defense -40 per stack.
- Reduces target's Evasion, Block, and Parry rates -0.5% per stack.
- Explodes at max stacks, dealing damage and tripping the target.
- Stacks up to 30 times.

passives.description: Increases Melee Attack +5%.

passives.name: Folding Time

passives.name: Wild Instincts

passives.name: Consecutive Evasion
passives.description: Increases Melee Evasion +18% for 7 seconds after a successful Evasion against melee attacks.

passives.name: Shield Edge

Has a small chance to stun the attacker when blocking a melee attack. 
This ability has a 12 sec cooldown once triggered.

passives.name: Zeal
passives.description:
Every successful Critical Damage/Critical Healing effect increases all Critical Rates (including Healing) +5% and all Critical Damage/Critical Healing +75% for 6 seconds.
This ability has a 12 sec cooldown once triggered.

passives.name: Absorb Damage

This ability has a 12 sec cooldown once triggered.

passives.name: Evasive Counterstrike

Triggers a counterattack when a Melee Attack is evaded.
Stacks 2 Bloodthirst when attacked.
This ability has a 12 sec cooldown once triggered.

passives.name: Unassailable
passives.description:
Grants a 1% chance to become immune to all damage for 2 seconds after receiving any damage.
This ability has a 20 sec cooldown once triggered.

passives.name: Painful Recharge

passives.description: Decreases Cast Time for all skills -5%.

passives.name: Baleful Recharge
passives.description:
Your successful attacks have a 2% chance to trigger the Baleful Recharge buff, restoring a percentage of your maximum mana with every attack for the following 5 seconds. This ability has a 12sec cooldown once triggered. In addition, each enemy you Fear using Banshee's Wail or Insidious Whisper grants a stack of Exploitation when the Fear effect expires.

Exploitation:
- Decreases the Cooldown of Focal Concussion and Enervate -10% per stack.
- Stacks up to 5 times.
- Casting either spell consumes one stack.
- While under the effects of Exploitation, both spells will deal 90% of their damage as mana burn instead of normal damage, restoring an equal amount of mana to you.

passives.name: Attack Speed Training
passives.description:
Decreases the cooldown of Battlerage skills-10%. Grants one stack of Delirium for every Battlerage Critical Hit, and for every enemy hit by the 3rd attack of Whirlwind Slash.

Delirium:
- Melee Skill Damage +2%.  
- Melee Critical Damage +5% .
- Stacks up to 5 times. 
- Grants a 5% chance of inflicting Bleed on targets.

passives.name: Supplemental Block
passives.description: Increases Block Rate +15% for 5 seconds after a successful Block.

passives.name: Guardian
passives.description: Permanently increases Aggro generation +50%.

passives.name: Dual-Wield Proficiency

When dual-wielding, Parry deflects Ranged Attacks as well.
Increases Melee Crit Rate +8%.

passives.name: Disregard

passives.name: Archery Expertise
passives.description: Decreases cooldown for Piercing Shot, Charged Bolt, Stalker's Mark, Missile Rain, Toxic Shot, and Snipe skills -10%.

passives.name: Teleportation Discipline
passives.description:
Teleportation has a 50% chance to eliminate its cooldown and allow consecutive teleports.
Mirror Warp has a 50% chance to sustain the buff and allow consecutive use.

Fiend's Knell now summons a more powerful fiend that last for 5 minutes, tripping enemies where it is summoned. Increases the cooldown on Fiend's Knell to 2min 30sec.

passives.name: Loudspeaker
passives.description: Increases the range for Quickstep, Ode to Recovery, Bloody Chantey, Bulwark Ballad, and Grief's Cadence to 22m.

passives.name: Syncopation
passives.description: Decreases the cast delay and the chance of interruption when hit -50%.

passives.name: Bloodthirst Intensified
passives.description: Doubles the amount of Bloodthirst granted by Shadowplay skills.

passives.name: Deflect and Retaliate
passives.description:
Permanently increases Parry rate +2%; each successful parry resets the cooldown on all Battlerage attack skills.
This ability has a 12sec cooldown once triggered.

passives.name: Puncture
passives.description: Melee Critical attacks decrease the target's Physical Defense -2000 for 5 seconds.

passives.name: Bear's Vigor
passives.description: Increases max health +900. Increases the effectiveness of Refreshment +20% and Toughen +33%.

passives.name: Hearten
passives.description: Doubles the duration of Inspire.

passives.name: Aranzeb's Infusion
passives.description: Increases Sorcery skill damage +15%.

passives.name: Caster's Enrichment
passives.description:
Decreases health regen -15 every second while not in combat and increases mana regen +15 every second while not casting.
Increases Attack Speed +5%.
Grants the Burning Brand buff for each enemy hit by Hell Spear, Summon Crows, or Stillness.


Burning Brand:
- Increases Occultism skill damage +2% per stack.
- Decreases channeling time of Absorb Lifeforce -3% per stack.
- Lasts 6sec.
- Stacks up to 15 times.
- Triggers Deathmark Aura at 15 stacks.

Deathmark Aura:
- Grants all accumulated bonuses of 15 stacks of Burning Brand.
- Reduces nearby enemies' damage by -15% 
- Lasts 12sec.
- Prevents gaining stacks of Burning Brand for duration.

passives.name: Defiance
passives.description:
Increases Magic Defense +500 for all allies within a 15m radius.
Grants the Prayer effect every time Antithesis, Mend, or Fervent Healing is cast.

Prayer:
- Decreases Cast Time -2% per stack.
- Triggers Sacrifice at 5 stacks.

Sacrifice:
- Consumes 12-16% of current health when triggered.
- Decreases Cast Time -10%.
- Adds powerful bonus effects to Mend and Infuse.
- Lasts 15sec.
- Prevents gaining stacks of Prayer for duration.

passives.name: Overpowered Spell Locus
passives.description:
Increases all Skill Damage +15% for up to 6 seconds after receiving damage.
Movement cancels the effect.
Does not apply to healing skills.

passives.name: Invigorated Healing

When using Caster's Enrichment, Crippling Mire grants a stack of Burning Brand for each enemy it hits beyond the first.

passives.name: Eagle Eyes
passives.description: Increases Ranged Accuracy +5% and Ranged Critical Rate +5%.

passives.name: Feral Claws
passives.description: Increases Archery skill damage +15%.

passives.name: Mana Flurry
passives.description:
Decreases Cast Time for all skills -6%.

Mana Fountain:
- Increases Attack Speed +20
- Decreases Cast Time -2%
- Decreases Sorcery skill cooldowns -2%

Rhythm:
